description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

around.description: Return only the landmark subtree containing this ref number. Use when you know a specific element's ref.

boxes.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

depth.description: Max depth of the returned subtree. Use with section/around to get a high-level overview first.

filename.description: Save snapshot to markdown file instead of returning it in the response.

section.description: Return only the subtree under this landmark (e.g. 'form', 'main', 'navigation "Footer"'). Reduces output by 90%+.

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

name: browser_snapshot
